title: Bulk Action For Forms
text:
## Bulk Action For Forms
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078793
A set of bulk actions is available for custom or brand-new forms under Toolbox >> Form Manager . These actions are not available for default forms.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180460927/original/qnHliJQswl5djVEsV_8XSdtBmeh_5kx43Q.png?1781549450 | alt: ]
The available bulk actions are Delete , Enable , and Disable :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180460936/original/R9Jf5Mjtan0p_-m8CJpEj4_QmfEaRVqeXg.png?1781549472 | alt: ]
NOTE: Bulk Delete permanently removes the selected forms and cannot be undone. If the goal is to deactivate forms while keeping them available for future use, use Disable instead.
To perform a bulk action on forms:
1. Select all forms using the select-all checkbox shown below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180461070/original/DJFbp-pERkuRj-jgjeDJbGJHpkcPBDX1qg.png?1781549597 | alt: ]
Or select the forms individually:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180461088/original/hVW1D5UnaDApZ8GHQRXwGzHXwVsrAWM2GQ.png?1781549635 | alt: ]
Then select one of the bulk actions available and click on Apply :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180461205/original/kEGdt56JDgmrlUC9_vF8HH3CyzNGNA0tcw.png?1781549687 | alt: ]
Once clicked, a confirmation pop-up will appear:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180461218/original/Zpwve-O1T9QzxN2R4lLJ5JKNaBpXZJZr4Q.png?1781549704 | alt: ]
Once confirmed, selected bulk action will apply to the selected forms:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180461242/original/1ZQ4A0WDL_qm4hKWGCvkqcLJ6zYZH2_sKw.png?1781549741 | alt: ]
